simple.meaning: תַּזְנוּת (taznûwth) is a Hebrew word meaning “harlotry , i.e. (figuratively) idolatry.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: תַּזְנוּת (H8457) appears 22 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezekiel 16:15, with occurrences in Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תַּזְנוּת (H8457) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in תַּזְנוּת (H8457) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: תַּזְנוּת (taznûwth) / H8457 is traced through Ezekiel 16:15, Ezekiel 16:20, Ezekiel 16:22, Ezekiel 16:25 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
